Bash(powershell -Command "

    alwaysMatch = @{
      platformName = 'Android'
      'appium:deviceName' = 'Samsung A54'
      'appium:udid' = 'R5CW710AMST'
      'appium:automationName' = 'UiAutomator2'
      'appium:noReset' = \\$true
      'appium:fullReset' = \\$false
    }
  }
}

\\$src.value | Out-File -FilePath 'C:\\Users\\pavel\\reg_current.xml' -Encoding UTF8
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri \\"http://localhost:4723/session/\\$sid\\" -Method DELETE | Out-Null
Write-Host 'Done'
" 2>&1)
